summary: 54 features and 9 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • hagitask: support ordered source overrides (fd6c6a2)
  • hagitask: add community task upgrade flow (6c04835)
  • preset-catalog: support vault and project registry target scopes (c531864)
  • hagitask: expose the preset description on the local HagiTask list (4d69f50)
  • hagitask: add the community gallery browse and install API (486a358)
  • hagitask: add user-configured folder task sources (072599c)
  • hagitask: expose management kind on the local HagiTask API (1b26391)
  • hagitask: persist enablement and surface the create proposal entry (5b8a403)
  • hagitask: list local presets and install from extracted folders (bc854eb)
  • hagitask: install community task presets from local archives (3a532f6)
  • proposal: add repository scope contract and content language (a8b09bf)
  • signalr: allow clients to pull the remote voice input snapshot (fdf97b7)
  • reports: surface timeline activity in the hero battle report (1697d6b)
  • orleans: expose the daily activity summary on the timeline grain (d8615db)
  • timeline: project daily activity summaries from shard storage (6ea10fd)
  • prompts: teach annotation processing to read markdown input (a7e3e37)
  • sessions: allow the owner project in target project references (374115b)
  • professions: add GPT 5.6 and HY3 secondary professions (dc29136)

HagiCode-org/web

  • i18n: add HagiTask source metadata labels (720cece)
  • hagitask: expose installation source metadata (c145499)
  • hagitask: upgrade community gallery tasks in place (d9dd9ec)
  • hagitask: add source reorder in management drawer (85fb8da)
  • i18n: update hagitask copy for gallery-only install (b5f526b)
  • hagitask: replace local folder install with community gallery (79652ee)
  • i18n: add sort drawer and change-order copy to hagitask (070fe16)
  • hagitask: move package ordering into a dedicated sort drawer (a11eb6f)
  • hagitask: link the community gallery to the contribution guide (f6c1167)
  • i18n: add community contribution copy to the gallery catalog (bba9837)
  • hagitask: add source and gallery tabs to the management drawer (f43ad32)
  • hagitask: add the community gallery panel components (43e6fb4)
  • hagitask: add the source management panel components (ce51890)
  • hagitask: show the installed task description in the detail panel (5c0ba73)
  • hagitask: add the community gallery api client (f6a7723)
  • hagitask: add the source management api client (b12b03e)
  • i18n: add source and gallery copy to the hagitask catalog (d1bb520)
  • i18n: move session creation copy into the hagitask catalog (3f99558)
  • session: gate creation actions on HagiTask enabled state (539f9d6)
  • hagitask: manage session creation entries from the drawer (86fccea)
  • hagitask: add the proposal projection and the enabled toggle (0b01eb5)
  • hagitask: localize the source kind and refresh the management copy (e9f482e)
  • proposal: remember the content language per hero (ccd6e6b)
  • proposal: resolve planning direction preview language and simplify selector (1de1207)
  • proposal: migrate repository-scope planning direction into stored defaults (3bcc45e)
  • hagitask: add HagiTask management drawer and community preset service (30913c9)
  • i18n: add OMP provider and session hero override strings (256dc5d)
  • conversation: normalize tool result content for grouping (a0776ce)
  • proposal: add content language and repository-scope direction (e1c807c)
  • voice-input: pull the active receiver when the remote page opens (4bea56e)
  • preset-task: expose a remote create command on the task drawer (078e9a2)
  • signalr: fetch the active remote voice input snapshot on demand (f259a38)
  • reports: show the yesterday activity overview panel (e8ea338)
  • reports: normalize the activity summary in the reports slice (540264f)
  • proposal: allow the owner project as a selectable reference (01b79af)
  • session: show session type indicator in session lists (4acfbd3)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • codebuddy: resume provider sessions without replaying prior answers (756c73b)
  • acp: render readable tool results from normalized CLI updates (76b2b5b)
  • analyzers: resolve XML doc and member hiding warnings (29a3001)
  • acp-verifier: initialize uninitialized non-nullable fields (6415eab)
  • git: accept a nullable root path when scanning for repositories (9ea5ac6)
  • httpapi: correct controller null handling and doc coverage (3a8373d)
  • version: strip source revision from reported product version (db043d7)

HagiCode-org/web

  • session: refresh the preset task catalog after managing HagiTasks (4528d9c)
  • profile: force a points refresh when the drawer opens (745de43)
